woocommerceOrderQuery.localEffect: reads WooCommerce order metadata and returns a PayPal Order entity; no WooCommerce order save or payment-state mutation
woocommerceOrderQuery.captureIsSeparate: OrderEndpoint::capture() uses POST /v2/checkout/orders/{order_id}/capture and will not be called
woocommerceOrderQuery.environmentSelection: PPCP api.host resolves from its stored Sandbox environment; fresh read-back selected Sandbox host and not production host
woocommerceOrderQuery.activeRequestArgumentFilter: PPCP ApiModule adds only the partner attribution header; it does not change method or URL

webhookEventQuery.purpose: read back the exact already-received event ID held by PPCP so event type, capture ID, PayPal order ID, and amount/currency can be correlated in memory
webhookEventQuery.nonMutatingBoundary: The official PayPal event self link is GET; the separate /resend action is POST and will not be called. The helper uses only wp_remote_get with no body and emits allowlisted fields and hashes only.
webhookEventQuery.localEffect: reads ppcp-last-webhook option and does not update WordPress or WooCommerce state
webhookEventQuery.callbackVerification: IncomingWebhookEndpoint registers a POST route with verify_request as permission_callback; signature verification defaults on unless PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_REQUEST_VERIFICATION is explicitly false, and is forced on in production. Storage::save runs only after permission verification in process_request. The reconciliation helper fails closed when verification is disabled.
webhookEventQuery.simulationExclusion: Configured simulation event type is CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED; simulation start is disabled in the installed plugin; the helper hashes the stored simulation ID and checks it does not equal the stored event ID before accepting capture webhook correlation.
webhookEventQuery.requestBoundary: The helper calls wp_remote_get with method GET, no body, no redirect, a bounded response size, and an allowlisted sanitized output. Active http_request_args and pre_http_request filters were verified empty before query execution. It does not call the /resend route.

authenticationSupport.service: The official PPCP bearer service reuses its cached token when valid; if expired, it may POST to /v1/oauth2/token using the connected Sandbox merchant credentials to obtain an access token.
authenticationSupport.boundary: This authentication-only request does not create or authorize a PayPal payment/order, capture, cancel, refund, or mutate WooCommerce payment state. The helper never outputs or persists the token in its evidence; the plugin may update its normal bearer cache if refresh is needed.

secretHandling: No Client ID, Client Secret, access token, cookie, authorization header, buyer credential, or raw provider response will be emitted or retained.
